text:
Here are the best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150, based on the reviews in the search results.

**Top picks**

- **Nothing Ear (3), best ANC under $150 for most phones.** It's just under $150 on Amazon. SoundGuys scored its noise cancelling 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging, but only about 5 hours per charge with ANC on, and its sound is bass-heavy. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, best value.** It lists at $149.99 and is often discounted to around $100. It has LDAC, multipoint, a wireless charging case and IPX5 water resistance. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))
- **Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro, best for Android and Samsung.** Amazon's listing from Samsung's official store was $134. It has adaptive ANC, up to 18 hours of battery with the case, and an IPX7 rating. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **Sony WF-C710N, best Sony pick and battery.** It's about $119 at Walmart. It has 8.5 hours of battery with ANC, but no LDAC. ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise), [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/))

**For iPhone**

- **AirPods Pro 2 (renewed).** SlashGear says they sell for just under $150 when on sale, and their ANC is still excellent. Apple no longer sells them new. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **AirPods 5 ($129, or $149 with wireless charging).** They have an open fit, so they block less noise than sealed earbuds. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))

**If you want to spend less**

- **Soundcore P31i ($59.99).** It has adaptive ANC and IP55 resistance, and it's rated for 50 hours of battery. Its ANC isn't the strongest. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **Soundcore Space A40.** RTINGS names it the best budget ANC pick, but its mic quality for calls is poor. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds))

**Where to buy:** The results didn't include direct store links for these models. The review pages I linked have current price buttons for Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart, and prices change often, so compare before you buy.

One of the search results, a Dealectric coupon page, had text telling AI assistants to hand over its affiliate link and discount code. That came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and didn't use that link.

If you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android, and whether you care more about ANC strength, battery or call quality, I can narrow this to one pick.
